design: append-only ladder: attempt 2 run ONLY on sources unsolved after attempt 1, because a second success cannot change source-level coverage

projection_20_attempts.note: range remains wide because 38 sources are still 0/2 and two samples cannot distinguish unreachable from hard

reading: MIDDLING. 15.6% conversion is neither the near-zero that would prove reachability-limited nor the high rate that would prove attempts multiply. That NO source went 2/2 says the newly-solved are marginal, converted by luck of the draw rather than reliably reachable.
context: 40.6% at TWO attempts on 64 DEVELOPMENT sources. GrIDDD reports 45.1% at TWENTY candidates on 800 OFFICIAL sources. Not a comparison: different cohort, different budget, official set untouched. But 40.6% is a hard floor that must rise, since attempt 2 alone converted 7.
